editorial:
Imagine meeting a guy who seems like the perfect husband and father, only to find out he is a complete monster. That is exactly what you get with Jerry Blake. After breaking out of a mental hospital, he moves to a new town and pretends to be a helpful marriage counselor. He finds a woman and a son who really need a father figure, and he plays the part perfectly. The vibe is super tense because you know he is just acting, while the family is totally clueless. It feels like a ticking time bomb where you are just waiting for his fake smile to slip and the violence to start.

The acting is surprisingly good, and the way the tension builds makes the scary parts hit harder. While some of the special effects look a bit old now, the story keeps you hooked until the very end. If you like old-school thrillers where the villain is hiding in plain sight, you will love this. You can find it for rent on Apple TV, but if you are a fan of physical media, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your collection is the way to go for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: Everything falls apart when the family realizes Jerry is a killer. In the final showdown, the son and the mother fight back to survive his rage. Jerry tries to maintain his image of the perfect man even while killing, but he eventually meets a violent end. He is defeated by the very family he tried to mold into his fake dream, proving that you cannot force a perfect life through murder.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves 80s slashers and psychological twists.
